name: Alor Setar Marathon 2026
short_description: A full marathon (42.195 km) and half marathon (21.1 km) held on August 14, 2026 in Alor Setar, Kedah, Malaysia; registration is closed.
ai_summary: The Alor Setar Marathon 2026 is a road race scheduled for August 14, 2026, in Alor Setar, Kedah, Malaysia. It offers two distance options: a full marathon of 42.195 km and a half marathon of 21.1 km, with the full marathon as the primary event. Registration for this edition is currently closed, so prospective participants will need to look out for future sign-up opportunities.
pros: Offers both a full marathon (42.195 km) and a half marathon (21.1 km) distance option
Takes place in Alor Setar, Kedah, a specific and clearly identified location in Malaysia
Has a confirmed, fixed event date of August 14, 2026
cons: Registration is already closed, so new participants cannot currently sign up
research_highlights: The 2026 edition offers five distance categories: 1km, 5km, 10km, 21km and 42km, starting from Dataran Pekan Rabu in Alor Setar, Kedah.

Race is organised/technical-run by Northern Runners, the same group behind other Kedah/Perlis races such as the Alor Setar Merdeka Half Marathon, Menara Alor Setar International Run, and Kangar City Half Marathon.
Event is scheduled for 14–15 August 2026 (Friday–Saturday), with a listed flag-off around 6:00pm and event window running into the early morning per registration platforms.
Registration fees for 2026 range roughly RM30–RM120 depending on category, with early-bird pricing and a registration closing date in mid-to-late 2026 depending on the listing source.
